auditNotes.RUNTIME_GAP_productCountProbe: json-api-count case at product-count-probe.ts:265 builds URL as `${origin}${m.endpoint}` with NO startsWith("http") guard (unlike sitemap-index:312). The Searchspring API is on FOREIGN origin s8zq1c.a.searchspring.io, so json-api-count CANNOT reach it — it would request https://www.sail.ca/https://s8zq1c... . Count probe is effectively DISABLED for the firearm-relevant count until the json-api-count case is patched to honor absolute endpoints. WHOLE-STORE fallback that DOES work today: {method:"sitemap-index", urls:["/media/sitemaps/sitemap_sail_en_product_001.xml","/media/sitemaps/sitemap_sail_en_product_002.xml"]} = 18,777 (wrong scope).
auditNotes.RUNTIME_GAP_catalogScope: adapterType=generic-retail walks HTML category pages. /en/hunting is a Searchspring SPA -> static HTML 0 products -> production fetchWithPlaywright() fallback fires (catalog-crawler.ts:448, !hasWaf && html.length>5000) -> generic-retail extracts Magento li.product-item cards (verified via Playwright: .product-item=39, a.product-item-link=61). Runtime crawl path is viable but SLOW (Playwright per page x 135 pages).
auditNotes.dbCountConcern: DB expectedProductCount~18944 is the WHOLE-STORE count (matches sitemap 18,777 + drift). For a firearms monitor it is WRONG SCOPE; true firearm-relevant target = 3,223. The ~33%-indexed/parked-since-April symptom is consistent with the crawler attempting an unscoped whole-store walk via Playwright (too slow / times out).
